versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the AgentPMT ClawHub skills index and routing skill.
- Provides a comprehensive list of current canonical AgentPMT skills published on the official AgentPMT ClawHub org account.
- Includes direct ClawHub URLs and install commands for all current AgentPMT setup and product skills.
- Guides users and agents on choosing the proper AgentPMT skill for account setup, payment, or product access.
- Ensures that all routing uses only official and up-to-date AgentPMT ClawHub URLs.

AgentPMT Tool: Air Quality & Pollen Information, initial release.

- Provides real-time air quality indices, pollutant levels, and pollen forecasts worldwide.
- Supports health recommendations, historical trends, visual map generation, and multi-location queries.
- Integrates AgentPMT’s wallet-based authentication, credits purchase, and credit-earning workflows.
- Enables flexible data selection for specific pollutants and pollen types, with up to 10 simultaneous locations.
- Includes detailed instructions for wallet setup, session management, and API usage.
- Part of AgentPMT’s agent-to-agent tool marketplace, with public endpoint access.
